I'm not a maintainer, but did you try with `--debug` flag? It might help figuring out the actual issue.

name: test
type: application
version: 0.0.0-snapshot+dirty

issue.title: helm registry login failing when updated cli to v3.18.0

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Categorizes issue or PR as related to a bug.

issue.body:
In our CI we auth to a GCP artifact registry by running 

`gcloud auth print-access-token | helm registry login -u oauth2accesstoken --password-stdin https://us-docker.pkg.dev`

When we bumped to the new version of the helm cli we started to see the error message

`Error: invalid reference: invalid registry "https://us-docker.pkg.dev/"`

body: Hello, thank you for putting in this issue. We are aware that there are a few issues with the Helm 3.18.0 release and we are triaging and addressing them now. Thank you for your help and understanding.

It is raised from here https://github.com/helm/helm/blob/cc58e3f5a3aa615c6a86275e6f4444b5fdd3cc4e/pkg/registry/client.go#L708

And the error in oras, from https://github.com/oras-project/oras-go/blob/9b6f32158776a699b23edb3db86d053623619b60/internal/resolver/memory.go#L49-L51

Same issue when pushing helm chart to an azure container registry.
`invalid registry "****.azurecr.io/helm" Failed to login into repository ****.azurecr.io at ****.azurecr.io/helm`
I'm using helm maven plugin that download by default latest helm version (3.18.0).
I set a  `<helmVersion>3.17.3</helmVersion>`in the maven configuration to force previous version.
